newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIANS DETERMINED TO DRINK FISH.
newsitem.headline: BELGIANS DETERMINED TO DRINK FISH.

text.p: The people in the Belgian town of Geraardsbergen have odd tastes in food -- once a year they drink small live fish swimming in glasses of white wine and no one, they say, is going to stop them.
"The festival will go on (on Sunday), and we will drink fish, like we do every year," a town hall official told Reuters on Friday.
Belgian animal rights group GAIA said drinking fish was against the law and they would file charges against anyone who did it at Sunday's "Krakelingen festival".

Drinking fish is a century-old celtic tradition in which the tiny gudgeons are scooped from a 16th-century bowl after a carnival parade. After the parade, cafes around the town square also serve the swimming delicacies.
